value.summary: Replaced the dynamic-execution implementation in lib/calc.mjs with a safe tokenizer plus recursive-descent parser supporting + - * /, integer literals, parentheses, optional unary minus, and whitespace. Precedence and left-associativity are conventional ("2+3*4" → 14, "10-4-3" → 3, "(2+3)*4" → 20), division returns the true quotient, and malformed input throws. The new file contains no reference to dynamic code execution APIs anywhere (checked as a static assertion in the tests too). Extended tests/calc.test.mjs with precedence, spacing, parentheses, associativity, division, nested-parens, invalid-input cases, and the static no-dynamic-execution check. Ran the suite with node --test; all tests pass. Satisfied: safe arithmetic parser in place, no dynamic execution in the file, tests green.
